Cell ROLL-1 MEASURED 8.5504 contacts per row on this same form, so about 9,234 contacts and about 3.5 GPU hours are the ESTIMATE for this arm -- never a target. Ceilings are bounds, and budgets are run-cumulative across every attempt of a run id.
